newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED ON HARD UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED ON HARD UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on sterling and the rand but closed weaker on the mark and the U.S. dollar on Wednesday, dealers said.

"One guy was selling aggressively in the market and the dollar went up as far as 10.7300/7500, prompting the (central) Reserve Bank to intervene, this time as a foreign currency buyer," commented one dealer.

He said the Zimbabwe dollar finished the day at 10.7450/7650 against the key U.S. dollar, a half cent loss over the previous day, and was also easier against the mark at 6.8840/8995 compared to late Tuesday's 6.8648/8811.

On pound sterling, however, the local unit closed stronger at 17.6590/7090 from 17.9283/9724, reflecting a firmer U.S. dollar against the British currency overseas, and was at 2.3025/3125 against the rand, a notch up from 2.3032/3101.
